notes.subject: verse numbering
notes.rationale: Hebrew 64:1 = English 64:2; KJV/Geneva 'rend the heavens' is Hebrew 63:19b, attached here in some traditions.

notes.subject: המסים
notes.rationale: hapax-like 'brushwood' vs. reading 'the melting' (הַמַסִים) as in 'melting fire'; JPS takes twigs, KJV context takes melting.

notes.subject: ombotremble
notes.rationale: ירגזו is 'tremble/quiver with fear or anger', broader than trembling alone.

notes.subject: המסים
notes.rationale: Dry twigs/brushwood — word appearing only here related to המס.

translation: Tatáu omoĩramo hína kaʼaguýre, tatáu omoĩramo hína ýre, ani hag̃ua ne téra ojekuaa ne ñorãirõhárape, nde reíme aja tetãnguéra ombotremble!
